description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/latlon3d/rules/upwind1_D_lon_periodic — first-order upwind lon derivative with explicit periodic wrap face on the rank-3 latlon3d grid. Every binding loads fixture.esm (NLON=8, NLAT=5, NLEV=4 bound at the import edge), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST for the model: D(u,lon) replaced by the rule's rank-3 two-region makearray (interior backward-difference stencil over [2,8] x [1,5] x [1,4]; full-rank wrap-face slab aggregate at the i=1 column over [1,1] x [1,5] x [1,4]), zero apply_expression_template nodes, zero unlowered rewrite-target ops, zero surviving metaparameter names, and the consumer-supplied spacing surviving as the free name dlon_deg. The golden is generated by the Julia reference runner only (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) and compared bytewise by the other bindings.
